thread:
IncidentBot: HIGH SEV Alert: VPC egress flapping for tenant 'syndicate' in eu-west-1 — >20% 502s and multiple connection resets across dedicated-pool-7. Auto-escalation to #incidents and oncall.

Alex (ops): pinging oncall @Jamie, looks like tenant-wide networking errors. Syndicate reported timeouts from their app metrics.

Jamie (oncall): on it. grabbing logs now. any impact to other tenants?

Rita (eng-runtime): quick check — noise localized to dedicated-pool-7 nodes hosting syndicate and a spare host. Network counters show RX drops on host03. Could be NIC/kernel issue.

Jamie (oncall): thanks Rita. Alex, can you page support to let Syndicate know we're investigating? Lina, can you take point for customer comms?

Lina (support): on it. will tell Sam (customer) we have an ops bridge and are isolating their workload. prepping a short status for execs.

Alex (ops): running tenant isolation to protect control plane and move traffic to fallback routing. command: 
```
rictl route-policy set --tenant syndicate --route fallback-hosted --priority 10
rictl pool migrate --from dedicated-pool-7 --to spare-pool-1 --tenant syndicate --drain
```

Rita (eng-runtime): suggests also temporarily disabling KV prefix caching for syndicate to avoid stale state while we move the pool. doing that now.

Jamie (oncall): applied route-policy, confirmed traffic shift to spare-pool-1. 502 rate dropped from 22% -> 3% in the last 60s. continuing drain on dedicated-pool-7.

Sam (Syndicate-ops): thank you. Can we get an ETA for full restoration? Their execs are on a call.

Lina (support): telling them ~15-25m while we finish migration and run validation. will post another update in 10m.

Rita (eng-runtime): kernel logs show repeated interrupts on host03 NIC. I opened a ticket to infra to replace node and pulled it out of rotation. We'll run post-mortem on why HW didn't failover earlier.

Alex (ops): confirmed node replaced from rotation. marking dedicated-pool-7 as degraded and scheduling automatic reprovision.

Marcus (cs): noted — CS will coordinate exec summary. Do we expect SLA credit? Syndicate has a 99.9% uptime agreement.

Rita (eng-runtime): preliminary root cause: NIC hardware flapping causing packet drops; combined with our kernel interrupt coalescing config, we saw a transient spike in packet handling latency that propagated into application-level 502s. Mitigation chain: 1) isolate tenant route 2) migrate to spare pool 3) replace degraded host.

Jamie (oncall): service back to normal for Syndicate. metrics look stable for last 10m. Will keep monitoring.

IncidentBot: Incident state -> mitigated. Duration 00:24:36. Pager closed by Jamie.

Sam (Syndicate-ops): appreciate the quick update. Requesting RCA and an exec note for their leadership.

Lina (support): we'll schedule a post-incident call. Marcus, can you lead the customer-facing note? propose standard timeline + brief technical appendix and proposed credits.

Marcus (cs): I can draft the customer note. Suggested credit: pro-rated for the 24-minute incident, plus a goodwill credit equivalent to 1 day of reserved capacity given impact to peak traffic. Need legal signoff but want to propose to Syndicate.

Rita (eng-runtime): I'll take the technical RCA. I'll include kernel traces, NIC vendor logs, and timeline of our mitigations. action item: add automated detection for NIC interrupt patterns to our observability runbook.

Alex (ops): also adding an action to tune interrupt coalescing defaults on pool-provisioner for our older hardware families.

Jamie (oncall): will add a follow-up to oncall runbook: when packet drops >5% for single-tenant pools, auto-suggest migration to spare-pool AND notify infra to check hardware sooner.

Lina (support): For comms cadence: Draft to Syndicate within 4 hours, technical appendix within 24 hours, offer a 30-min exec debrief in next 48 hours. Marcus, Sam: are those ok?

Sam (Syndicate-ops): that works. they'd like the exec debrief on tomorrow PST morning if possible.

Marcus (cs): locking that in. I'll send a first draft in ~3h. Lina will coordinate the meeting invite.

Rita (eng-runtime): RCA ETA: 18h. Will include reproducer script and recommended mitigations (kernel tuning + hardware replacement cadence).

Alex (ops): post-incident tasks assigned: 
- Rita: produce technical RCA (1839991234-RCA)
- Jamie: update oncall runbook + add automated suggestion rule
- Alex: reprovision pool defaults and schedule hardware lifecycle audit
- Marcus/Lina: customer comms + credit proposal

Jamie (oncall): all set from SRE side. closing bridge but keeping watch on alerting thresholds for 24h. ping me if they see anything.

IncidentBot: Note appended: RCA in progress, CS draft pending.

Lina (support): thanks team. Sam, we'll DM you the exec note when Marcus posts. :thumbsup:

Sam (Syndicate-ops): thanks everyone. Appreciate the clear steps and quick mitigation.

Marcus (cs): draft sent to #cs-review and to Sam. pls review for tone — want concise exec summary + one-slide tech appendix.

Rita (eng-runtime): uploading kernel logs and timeline to the RCA doc. added suggested follow-ups and priority tags.

Alex (ops): marking incident as resolved in internal tracker. leaving open follow-ups until RCA and customer acceptance complete.

Jamie (oncall): ACK. good job team. :clap:

(End of thread)
